entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number is VF88-192-C.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF88-192-C. I see it here. This is for the AeroPro cycling shoes, is that correct?
That's them. I want to return them.
I can certainly look into that for you. So I can understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They just don't work for me. The fit is terrible and no matter how I adjust the cleats, they cause blisters on my arches. I'm not interested in troubleshooting, I just want a refund.
I understand completely. No one wants blisters from their gear. Let me just confirm the delivery date... I see they were delivered to you 29 days ago.
And? Are you going to process this or not?
Yes, absolutely. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can process this for you right now.

Of course. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Just pack up the cycling shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive them, we'll issue the full refund back to your original payment method.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
